implementationTasks.title: Enforce the Task Server steering boundary
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Enforce the Task Server steering boundary

Source: docs/task-server-bus/index.html (AGT-2905), D5, based on develop d713e8a156b565374166d545a0f079dc8be23926. Follow the operator's recorded choice when promoted; the Dossier recommendation is not a decision receipt. Related architecture: AGT-W49 at docs/operations/operations-server-backchannel/index.html and AGT-W57 at docs/operations/delivery-chain/index.html.

Dependency: none; independent bounded slice. Use the promoted task keys for these slice dependencies, and verify their contracts before implementation.

Context
The standalone EngineTaskServerClient already posts only to the Task Server, but backend TaskRunnerService can invoke ProjectRunner directly and V1ReviewPlaneEndpoints performs policy/integration in its request. AttemptAuthorityEndpoints exposes low-level settlement separately from delivery.

Deliver
Define and implement an authenticated, versioned steering boundary in the Task Server for engine actions. Bind each action to task identity, expected current generation, actor and reason. Keep policy choice in the engine and validation/authority in the server. Route local execution through an adapter to the existing claim/lease contract, without adding daemon listeners. Restrict low-level settlement so it cannot masquerade as full reviewed/integrated delivery. Document a deployment choosing exactly one authoritative backend; do not dual-write SQLite and task.json as peers.

Acceptance
- Engine integration test uses only Task Server URLs, with daemon network endpoints unavailable.
- Stale-generation actions fail without lane or attempt mutation; an accepted action can be read back with actor/reason.
- Local and remote execution cannot acquire concurrent authority for the same task; low-level settle alone cannot satisfy delivery completion.

Scope and verification
Do not migrate every operation in W49, build an Operations Server, or replace the storage engine. Read docs/concepts/orchestrator-drive-to-conclusion.html before changing outcome logic. Add the narrowly needed architecture/contract documentation and boundary tests.
Read AGENTS.md and docs/start/contribution-and-style-guide.html. The canonical model-routing policy applies to any model settings. Leave platform Git ownership with the application. Report changed files, exact verification and any unverified deployment assumption.

implementationTasks.title: Persist versioned continuation intent and consumption receipts
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Persist versioned continuation intent and consumption receipts

Source: docs/task-server-bus/index.html (AGT-2905), D6, based on develop d713e8a156b565374166d545a0f079dc8be23926. Follow the operator's recorded choice when promoted; the Dossier recommendation is not a decision receipt. Related architecture: AGT-W49 at docs/operations/operations-server-backchannel/index.html and AGT-W57 at docs/operations/delivery-chain/index.html.

Dependency: I1. Use the promoted task keys for these slice dependencies, and verify their contracts before implementation.

Context
TaskRunnerService appends prompts, SavePendingIntent overwrites pending-intent.json, and Ready promotion is separate. The remote path has no uniform intent revision/consume receipt.

Deliver
Implement one server-owned continuation intent with command id, task revision, target attempt or next round, authored prompt revision, model/CLI/thinking fields and reason. Use the model-routing policy for validation without silently changing explicit selections. Accept the prompt/spec revision and queued state consistently before returning queued. Return the same receipt for an identical retry; reject reused ids with different payloads. Record exactly which admitted run consumed the intent and preserve it when spawn fails. Define ordered or explicitly superseded rounds rather than silent latest-wins loss. Keep active-run retuning out of scope.

Acceptance
- Two distinct submitted rounds retain traceable receipts and neither silently disappears.
- Identical retries return one receipt; payload conflict and stale task revision produce explicit rejection.
- Crash between acknowledgement, claim and spawn preserves recoverable intent; only the matching run can mark it consumed.

Scope and verification
Limit changes to steering persistence, continue/claim adapters and contract tests. Do not redesign the task UI; provide the new API projection for later I6. Preserve concept/coding mode admission guards.
Read AGENTS.md and docs/start/contribution-and-style-guide.html. The canonical model-routing policy applies to any model settings. Leave platform Git ownership with the application. Report changed files, exact verification and any unverified deployment assumption.

implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Make remote stop requests durable and attempt scoped

Source: docs/task-server-bus/index.html (AGT-2905), D7, based on develop d713e8a156b565374166d545a0f079dc8be23926. Follow the operator's recorded choice when promoted; the Dossier recommendation is not a decision receipt. Related architecture: AGT-W49 at docs/operations/operations-server-backchannel/index.html and AGT-W57 at docs/operations/delivery-chain/index.html.

Dependency: I1. Use the promoted task keys for these slice dependencies, and verify their contracts before implementation.

Context
RemoteRunStopRequestStore currently uses a ConcurrentDictionary and intentionally loses requests on backend restart. LeaseHeartbeat consumes a stop directive while the holder still has authority.

Deliver
Persist stop command identity, target task/attempt/fence, reason, expiry and requested/observed/terminal receipt. Return a durable receipt before acknowledging stop. Deliver through the existing lease renewal response. Retire requests on terminal settlement or supersession; do not stop a successor attempt. Keep park/hold semantics separate from stopping an active worker. Reuse salvage and Stopped completion behavior for follow-up pause.

Acceptance
- Restart after stop acknowledgement but before heartbeat still delivers the request to its original attempt.
- Duplicate requests are idempotent; old stop cannot affect a new fenced attempt.
- User stop and follow-up pause retain their current salvage and lane outcomes, including when the route is temporarily unavailable.

Scope and verification
No direct SSH/process-control RPC from the engine and no changes to authority expiry. Read the drive-to-conclusion contract; add deterministic restart and generation-race tests.
Read AGENTS.md and docs/start/contribution-and-style-guide.html. The canonical model-routing policy applies to any model settings. Leave platform Git ownership with the application. Report changed files, exact verification and any unverified deployment assumption.

acceptanceScope.slice: I3 Make remote stop requests durable and attempt scoped

implementationTasks.title: Persist review settlement continuation before acknowledgement
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Persist review settlement continuation before acknowledgement

Source: docs/task-server-bus/index.html (AGT-2905), D8, based on develop d713e8a156b565374166d545a0f079dc8be23926. Follow the operator's recorded choice when promoted; the Dossier recommendation is not a decision receipt. Related architecture: AGT-W49 at docs/operations/operations-server-backchannel/index.html and AGT-W57 at docs/operations/delivery-chain/index.html.

Dependency: none; independent bounded slice. Use the promoted task keys for these slice dependencies, and verify their contracts before implementation.

Context
V1ReviewPlaneEndpoints settles authority before best-effort sidecar persistence and enqueues evidence into RemoteReviewEvidenceProjectionQueue. Duplicate reports return early. RemoteDeliveryIntegrationCoordinator is in memory; AutoReviewDeliveryResumeService depends on a matching durable sidecar.

Deliver
Make the file-backed report workflow durably journal the canonical report payload and pending evidence, integration and lane projections before a successful acknowledgement. Reconcile unfinished projection work on startup and ordinary ticks with bounded retries. Preserve ReviewAttempt as sole verdict authority, immutable SHA identity and idempotency. Reuse RemoteDeliverySettlementStore and AutoReviewDeliveryResumeService rather than introducing a competing verdict store. Missing or corrupt journal data must yield a typed repair state, never an inferred pass. Compare the standalone store contract and document differences rather than claiming the monolith fix covers both.

Acceptance
- Inject process death after authority settlement, before sidecar write, before evidence enqueue, after integration and before lane move; each supported window converges or reports typed repair.
- Duplicate report never reruns the review or double-integrates; pending evidence still becomes recoverable.
- A successor review generation prevents every stale projection, integration and lane continuation from applying.

Scope and verification
Scope is one review-report settlement workflow, not a general message broker or database migration. Add restart regression tests and update the review-plane contract. Do not change gate policy or human acceptance rules.
Read AGENTS.md and docs/start/contribution-and-style-guide.html. The canonical model-routing policy applies to any model settings. Leave platform Git ownership with the application. Report changed files, exact verification and any unverified deployment assumption.

implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Rehearse tunnel loss and fenced recovery for coding and review

Source: docs/task-server-bus/index.html (AGT-2905), D9, based on develop d713e8a156b565374166d545a0f079dc8be23926. Follow the operator's recorded choice when promoted; the Dossier recommendation is not a decision receipt. Related architecture: AGT-W49 at docs/operations/operations-server-backchannel/index.html and AGT-W57 at docs/operations/delivery-chain/index.html.

Dependency: I3, I4. Use the promoted task keys for these slice dependencies, and verify their contracts before implementation.

Context
AGT-2905 cites the operator-reported 2026-09-24/25 tunnel incident, but no dated incident log is present in the source snapshot. Existing LeaseHeartbeat, RemoteTaskRunner, durable outbox and finalization/review reconcilers define bounded authority and replay.

Deliver
Add a controlled infrastructure drill that interrupts only the test runner-to-Task-Server route. Record granted expiry, stop-before, worker teardown, fence/epoch, quarantine ref/SHA/push status, outbox identity and final receipt. Exercise a short interruption within valid authority, an interruption beyond authority (both exact-current re-adoption and superseded rejection), daemon restart, server restart, lost report acknowledgement and an already-settled delivery needing integration resume. Keep synthetic drill times distinct from historical incident claims. Use isolated fixtures, bounded waits and cleanup; never disrupt a production tunnel.

Acceptance
- No worker continues past its granted safety boundary and no stale generation changes task authority.
- Valid duplicate delivery is replayed once in effect; rejected/superseded work is quarantined and replacement work starts under a new claim; expiry-only re-adoption requires exact positive evidence and a new server confirmation.
- One report correlates outage, affected coding/review attempts and recovered or unresolved terminal states, with raw evidence retained.

Scope and verification
Do not alter safety deadlines to make the drill pass. Follow machine-bound test tagging and stable-owned Playwright backend lifecycle rules where applicable. Document the runbook and exact commands; a live infrastructure dependency failure is explicit evidence, not a fake green replay.
Read AGENTS.md and docs/start/contribution-and-style-guide.html. The canonical model-routing policy applies to any model settings. Leave platform Git ownership with the application. Report changed files, exact verification and any unverified deployment assumption.

implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Route work to capable host classes with bounded admission

Source: docs/task-server-bus/index.html (AGT-2905), D11, based on develop d713e8a156b565374166d545a0f079dc8be23926. Follow the operator's recorded choice when promoted; the Dossier recommendation is not a decision receipt. Related architecture: AGT-W49 at docs/operations/operations-server-backchannel/index.html and AGT-W57 at docs/operations/delivery-chain/index.html.

Dependency: none; independent bounded slice. Use the promoted task keys for these slice dependencies, and verify their contracts before implementation.

Context
LeaseEndpoints filters project assignment through IsAssignedRemote/IsAssignedAndRoutable. Fresh capabilities, central host slot ceilings, telemetry and project access already exist. The target assumes many interchangeable runner hosts.

Deliver
Add a class/capability requirement to project or task placement while retaining explicit pins for genuinely local work. Select eligible registered hosts using fresh capability, principal/project access, effective slots and load. Keep coding and review budgets distinct, and preserve sequential execution within a project unless existing orchestrator-gated maxParallelism authorizes more. Define authenticated join, drain and remove semantics. Adding a second matching host must require no task rewrite; abrupt removal waits for authority expiry and recovery rather than transferring a live lease.

Acceptance
- Two matching hosts can serve a project; loss/drain of one routes subsequent eligible claims to the other without task edits.
- Incompatible, stale, unauthorized or over-capacity hosts cannot claim; pins and project concurrency limits still hold.
- Capacity version acknowledgement, class selection/rejection reason and drain state are queryable; host registration alone does not acknowledge applied capacity.

Scope and verification
Do not implement unbounded intra-project fan-out or hot migration. Target counts are N >= 2 Linux, M = 0 or >= 2 Windows if required, W >= 0 workstations, not hard-coded fleet sizes. Cover deterministic selection/expiry tests and document the placement contract.
Read AGENTS.md and docs/start/contribution-and-style-guide.html. The canonical model-routing policy applies to any model settings. Leave platform Git ownership with the application. Report changed files, exact verification and any unverified deployment assumption.

# Use the runner-host contract on operator workstations

Source: docs/task-server-bus/index.html (AGT-2905), D12, based on develop d713e8a156b565374166d545a0f079dc8be23926. Context
AGT-W49 depicts a distinct Workstation Agent. The operator recommendation is to remove that execution role while preserving the browser Connector and native host-manager boundaries.

Deliver
Package/adapt the same runner-host implementation for a workstation. Advertise bounded local repository roots, Windows tooling and preview URL capabilities under the existing scoped principal and claim/lease/report contract. Local-only tasks may remain explicitly pinned; ordinary work must be interchangeable with another capable host. Keep browser session, Host/Origin/CSRF and secret handling in their existing edge. Define preview reachability/lifetime as an artifact capability, not a hidden shared path.

Acceptance
- A workstation claims and reports ordinary work through the same contract as another runner host, without a new task authority or daemon RPC.

- Deployment/topology documentation removes the separate Workstation Agent execution role while explaining the retained Connector/host manager.

Scope and verification
No broad Connector migration or full Operations Server implementation. Use appropriate Windows machine-bound integration checks plus portable contract tests. Preserve isolated execution preparation and do not expose browser credentials to workers.

implementationTasks.title: Execute versioned quality library steps through review-capable runner hosts
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Execute versioned quality library steps through review-capable runner hosts

Source: docs/task-server-bus/index.html (AGT-2905), D13, based on develop d713e8a156b565374166d545a0f079dc8be23926. Follow the operator's recorded choice when promoted; the Dossier recommendation is not a decision receipt. Related architecture: AGT-W49 at docs/operations/operations-server-backchannel/index.html and AGT-W57 at docs/operations/delivery-chain/index.html.

Dependency: I7. Use the promoted task keys for these slice dependencies, and verify their contracts before implementation.

Context
RemoteReviewDaemon and RemoteReviewExecutor already execute server-supplied plans in exact-subject workspaces with review leases and separate slots. The target removes the dedicated Quality Host Agent role.

Deliver
Represent review aspects, gates and verification as versioned shared-library steps with explicit step id/version/digest, input subject, required capabilities and resource budget. Resolve that plan server-side; the review mode of the same runner-host agent executes it under its review slot budget. Return actual subject SHA, command timing/exit data, verdict citations, evidence hashes, executor attribution and cleanup receipt in the existing fenced review report. Keep plan changes on a new/replanned eligible attempt, never silently mutate a leased immutable subject.

Acceptance
- The same review-library step runs on two eligible hosts and returns equivalent identity/evidence contracts.
- Missing capability prevents claim, review load cannot spend coding slots accidentally, and wrong SHA/fence/step digest is rejected.
- Report retry, supersession and cleanup preserve existing exact-subject/replay guarantees; diagrams/docs have no distinct Quality Host Agent.

Scope and verification
Do not introduce a workflow engine, new quality daemon protocol, or new gate policy. Reuse RemoteReviewPlanBuilder, V1ReviewPlaneEndpoints and standalone equivalents with compatibility tests. Document step-envelope additions and version negotiation.
